jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description_text:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

 About the role

 As a Senior Product Designer on the Pair team, you'll help design how people collaborate and communicate during a live technical interview. You'll identify problems worth solving and design innovative, high-quality solutions that resonate with users, partnering closely with product managers and engineers through interaction and visual design.

 At HackerRank, we believe the future is human plus AI. This role sits at the heart of that belief: you'll design next-gen interviewing experiences where developers showcase their skills in an AI-first world, and you'll build those designs the same way, working alongside AI agents every day.

 What you will do

• Design and ship features that balance proven UI paradigms with new AI-powered interaction patterns.

• Translate design intent (layout, hierarchy, motion, interaction states, edge cases) into instructions an agent can build from, knowing when to show rather than tell.

• Iterate in tight loops: reviewing agent output critically, diagnosing why something feels off, and steering the next iteration instead of starting over.

• Build taste into the system by encoding visual and interaction standards into reusable prompts, components, and guidelines so quality compounds across the team.

• Pressure-test your ideas and refine through collaboration and research.

• Partner with engineering, product management, and design peers on both long-term strategy and short-term execution.

• Care about the full user journey: from the moment a candidate receives an invite through the interviewer's final read-out.

• Manage competing priorities and act decisively in the face of ambiguity.

• Contribute to design and product culture at HackerRank, including how the team uses agents to raise the bar.

 Who you are

• 5+ years of hands-on industry experience as a product designer, with at least 3 years on fast-moving enterprise or consumer products.

• Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar. You can show real work you've built by directing agents, work that you or others actually used, and explain the prompting and iteration decisions behind it.

• A portfolio demonstrating excellent visual, UI, and interaction design, ideally including interactive or in-code work, not just static screens.

• Comfort with ambiguity, working independently or across many stakeholders, and balancing established design standards with new paradigms.

• Proven ability to ship high-quality products in a self-directed manner.

 Even better if you have

• Experience designing live, real-time, or high-stakes collaborative experiences.

• The ability to build front-end and work directly in code yourself, not just direct agents.

• Experience adopting new tools fast and staying ahead of a monthly-changing agent landscape, treating that change as an advantage.

• Experience creating design systems, components, or guidelines that other designers and engineers build against.

 You will thrive in this role if you

• Designing through agents is already your daily workflow, not an experiment you're running.

• You think in working software. You'd rather hand engineering a functioning prototype than a redlined mock, and you know how that changes the conversation.

• You know what quality looks like and how to get agents to produce it; you catch the 10% an agent gets wrong and know exactly how to steer the fix.

• You've seen how a small micro-interaction or personalized moment drives engagement, and you sweat those details.

• You care about live, high-stakes experiences: an interview is a stressful, real-time moment for candidates and interviewers alike, and designing calm into it excites you.

• You aren't shy about sharing what you learn and helping lift the bar for everyone.

 Want to learn more about HackerRank? Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here .

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

• Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses. 

• We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description_text:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

 From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

 The Role: 
 You are someone who believes that good design has a role in the solution to every problem. You know that design is not just how things look and feel, but also how every process evolves. Even mundane processes from daily life can be made easier with design. You love products and have great creative skills. You want to own and be responsible for designing and driving products to completion. You religiously follow Buxton’s rule of producing at least 3 alternatives for every design decision. You respect the grid and hate all the half pixel aligned icons.
 
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
As a Senior Product Designer, you will: 
 ● Take part in product and design ideation, planning and prioritization of our diverse range of products and features. 
 ● Drive user research, create detailed user journeys and take appropriate design decisions backed by user-behavior and data. Define design strategies by analyzing data models and derive best practices within the team.Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams including Product, Engineering, Marketing and various Business teams to deliver delightful customer experiences. 
 ● Strategize, develop, and extend the visual design systems and pattern libraries by coming up with new and innovative solutions which suit the Razorpay brand. 
 ● Take part in creative and holistic thinking across our diverse products and conduct design reviews and status meetings as needed. 
 ● Evangelize design within and outside the organization. 
 ● Brainstorm and create new directions that Razorpay can take in our quest to make payments easy and accessible to all. 
 ● Effectively mentor and inspire a team of designers. Help the team in raising the bar, resolving blockers, prioritizing and breaking down complex projects into simpler tasks.
 
 Mandatory Qualifications: As a Senior Product Designer, we expect you to have : 
 ● 4+ years of experience in designing digital products. 
 ● Ability to understand short and long-term goals of the product and business. 
 ● Keen in applying user research, user-needs validation and usability evaluation. Excellent understanding of user-centered design and visual design principles. 
 ● You understand the importance of behavioral analytics and you go by data-driven decisioning, when needed. 
 ● A good understanding of Frontend principles to guide the team from an engineering point of view. 
 ● Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to the team and leadership. 
 ● Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design and ship new features. 
 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. 

 Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description_text:
Headquarters: Canada
 
 URL: https://pixel-one.com/ 

 Full-time · Remote (Canada based preferred) 

 Pixel One is a design studio for ambitious B2B SaaS teams. We embed with our clients, join their standups, and stay with their product as it evolves. Average client retention is 24+ months, which means you'll see what your work does to a business over years, not weeks.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own client work from concept through final delivery. This is not a role where you execute someone else's brief. You'll understand the business strategy behind each project, identify the user experience problems our client's customers have been stuck on, and use design to solve them.

 You'll work directly with our leadership, our client's leadership, our design leads and you'll direct specialists in motion, and illustration on your projects.

 Qualifications

• 7+ years designing digital products (ideally with an agency)

• Strong fundamentals:

• Excellence in communication (can communicate with a team and various stakeholders)

• Excellence in aesthetic (UI/Visual design)

• Excellence in craft (Figma Hygiene, design principles and delight)

• Excellence in strategy (Can interpret vague requirements and clarify them + can drive product change through compelling concepts, prototypes and mockups)

• Expert-level Figma. Comfort with prototyping (AI or traditional tools) and motion is a strong plus

• Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and delegate work to a teammate (production designer)

• Confident communicator who can present and defend work directly to senior clients and founders. Our clients are opinionated and educated about design, it's not your typical agency! You will need to defend great design less vigorously but it will be expected more often.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and able to move fast without dropping quality

• Self-driven and organized enough to run your own project workflows without being managed

 Responsibilities

• Produce design work at a consistently high quality tier, with meticulous attention to craft, precision, and completeness.

• Define the design challenge at a strategic level, connecting solutions to client goals, strategy, and business vision. Identify the historical positioning problems behind each brief and design with those in mind

• Build and maintain style kits that give the team and collaborators a clear, consistent visual language

• Brief and coordinate specialists: translate client requirements into actionable direction for production designers and give feedback that keeps output aligned with the creative vision

• Communicate proactively with clients: estimate effort and timelines accurately, respond to Slack within one business hour during working hours.

• Own projects end to end, from brief through final delivery

• Maintain asset hygiene: files clean, structured, and aligned with team fundamentals

• Manage project operations in Notion, keeping planning pages, task boards, and meeting notes current without being prompted

• Prioritize effectively, focusing on the right tasks in the right order at the right time

• Participate actively in team rituals: crits, elevate sessions, and growth activities

 Highlights

 Meaningful work: Partner directly with founders and executives at companies building serious products. Your designs ship to real users and move real businesses. Our clients come back after they exit. We develop deep relationship with them which means we're able to see the impact of our work overtime (unheard of in a traditional agency).

 Exceptional team: Work alongside designers who are generous collaborators, not competitors. Everyone here is deeply skilled and genuinely invested in lifting the team up.

 Remote: We're distributed (mostly across Canada) and flexible about where you work, as long as you cover PT and ET hours with stellar internet.

 Offsites: We meet in person at least 2 times per year! These are good moments to get the team together, celebrate our accomplishments and align on a unified vision. Past locations: Montreal, Toronto, Barcelona, Greece, Miami, Mont-Tremblant, Tulum

 Growth investment: We cover courses, workshops, and other learning you want to pursue. Just bring it to your manager. We also run weekly elevate sessions where the team sharpens design and thinking skills together.

 Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Work with motion designers, illustrators, and other specialists. You'll expand your craft and find more opportunities for delight.

 ️ Clarity: You'll know what's expected of you, what you need to succeed in the role, and how to grow beyond it.

 ⛑️ Health insurance: All Canada based employees receive private health insurance.

 How to Apply

 All applications will be reviewed through our recruiting system, and we'll reach out to selected candidates with the next steps.

 Please submit your application using our application form .

** Do not contact any team member by direct messaging, social media or any other way. Use the form to apply 

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pixel-one-senior-product-designer

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 
 Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.
 Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.
 For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.
 Location & work mode 
 Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. 
 What you'll do 
 
• Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

• Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

• Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

• Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

• Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

• Use and improve our lightweight design system components

• Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

 What we’re looking for 
 
• 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

• Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

• Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

• Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

• Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

• Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

 What we offer 
 We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:
 
• Competitive salary and equity

• Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

• Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

• Paid co-working space or desk

• Health coverage (based on country requirements)

• 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

• 4 months paid parental leave

• Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

• Regular team events and off-sites

• Remote-first with no required commute

 Learn how we think and work

• Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear 

• Read me a story about our mission 

• Why and how we do work trials Linear blog post 

• How we structure our product teams talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024 

• Crafting quality that endures Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen 

• Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear Accel Series B blog post 

 Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Headquarters: Remote
 
 URL: http://gowalter.co 

 Description 

 Product Designer (UX/UI Designer – SaaS Products) – Remote 

 Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico (Remote)
 Position Type: Full-Time
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

 About the Role 

 At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end user experience across modern web and mobile SaaS applications.

 This role goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, interface design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive digital experiences that improve usability, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.

 Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into elegant, production-ready designs while ensuring consistency across the entire product ecosystem.

 If you think in **user journeys, workflows, and systems—not just screens—**this role is built for you.

 What You’ll Own 

 UX Research & Product Discovery 

• Conduct user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.

• Translate research into:

• User personas

• Journey maps

• User flows

• Information architecture

• Product requirements

• Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.

• Use product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to support design decisions.

 UX/UI Design 

• Design wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity user interfaces.

• Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

• Design intuitive workflows that improve usability and task completion.

• Deliver polished SaaS experiences aligned with modern UX best practices.

 Design Systems & Component Libraries 

• Build and maintain scalable design systems.

• Create reusable UI components and design patterns.

• Establish standards for:

• Typography

• Color systems

• Spacing

• Interaction patterns

• Accessibility

• Ensure visual consistency across all product experiences.

 User Experience Optimization 

• Conduct usability testing and collect customer feedback.

• Run A/B tests on:

• Layouts

• User flows

• Navigation

• Interaction patterns

• Improve:

• User engagement

• Retention

• Feature adoption

• Conversion rates

• Iterate designs using research findings and product analytics.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

• Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle.

• Participate in product planning, discovery sessions, and design reviews.

• Deliver developer-ready designs using:

• Figma Dev Mode

• Zeplin

• Design documentation

• Provide clear interaction specifications and implementation guidance.

 Accessibility & Design Quality 

• Design experiences aligned with WCAG accessibility standards.

• Ensure usability across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

About Avalere Health 

 United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE . At Avalere Health , we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
 Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 
 Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources. 
 Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 
 We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves. 
 We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.
 About the Role
 As a Senior UX Designer, you'll play a central role in shaping the user experience and design of digital products built for the healthcare marketing industry. You'll work hands-on to create intuitive, accessible, and empathetic experiences for websites and interactive pieces that serve patients, healthcare providers (HCPs), and caregivers.
 You'll own end-to-end UX delivery for your assigned projects, with strategic oversight from the UX Director. On larger-scale engagements, you'll often partner with a Lead UX Designer, contributing both hands-on craft and design thinking. Your work directly impacts real people navigating complex health journeys, so you'll balance business goals, user needs, and regulatory realities in equal measure.
 What you'll do
 
 Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End UX Design & Deliverables

 Own the full UX lifecycle for your projects and produce the artifacts that move work from concept to launch, including:

• 
 Information architecture — sitemaps, taxonomies, navigation models, and content structures.

• 
 User flows & journey maps — mapping task paths, decision points, and multi-state experiences (e.g., HCP vs. patient, pre- vs. post-authentication).

• 
 Wireframes — low- to high-fidelity wireframes that clearly communicate structure, hierarchy, and interaction.

• 
 Interactive prototypes — clickable Figma prototypes for stakeholder review and usability testing.

• 
 Interaction & responsive design — detailed interaction specs, states, and behavior across breakpoints and devices.

• 
 Design specifications & developer handoff — annotated UX documentation that gives development teams what they need to build accurately.

• 
 Accessibility annotations — WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA guidance including focus order, keyboard navigation, ARIA intent, and inclusive design considerations built in from the start.

• 
 Regulated content structure — designing experiences that accommodate compliance requirements such as fair balance, ISI placement, and referencing, in partnership with medical/regulatory reviewers.

• 
 Design QA — reviewing built experiences against design intent and flagging discrepancies.

• 
 UX Design system contributions — building, extending, and maintaining reusable components and patterns to keep work consistent and efficient.

 User Research & Usability Testing

• Plan and conduct user research and usability testing sessions.

• Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into clear, actionable insights.

• Incorporate findings into UX iterations to ensure experiences are intuitive, accessible, and engaging while meeting user needs and business goals.

• Use research and analytics to validate design decisions and measure success.

 Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

• Partner closely with strategy, creative, copy, account, and development teams to translate complex requirements into intuitive solutions.

• Serve as a key advisor to creative teams on accessibility and compliance standards.

• Act as a critical bridge between user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.

• Navigate regulated review workflows (e.g., MLR/PRB), designing in a way that anticipates and supports the review process.

 Client & Stakeholder Communication

• Confidently present design concepts to clients and internal stakeholders.

• Clearly articulate design choices and their strategic impact on user outcomes and business goals.

• Facilitate workshops and design discussions and tell a compelling story through your work.

 AI-Enabled Workflow

• Comfortably integrate AI tools into the design process — accelerating research synthesis, ideation, content drafting, prototyping, and documentation — while maintaining strong craft, critical judgment, and quality control.

• Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and help the team identify where they add genuine value to UX outcomes.

 About you
 
 Qualifications

 Required 

• 8+ years of UX/product design experience, including leading design on projects end to end. 

• A strong portfolio demonstrating full-lifecycle UX work — research, IA, wireframes, prototypes, and shipped experiences — across responsive web and interactive platforms. 

• Proficiency in Figma, including prototyping and component/design-system workflows. 

• Deep working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA) and inclusive design practices. 

• Solid grasp of visual design fundamentals (typography, color, layout, hierarchy). 

• Demonstrated experience planning, running, and synthesizing user research and usability testing. 

• Proficiency with UX/product analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Hotjar) to inform and measure design. 

• Excellent presentation and communication skills, with comfort presenting to and defending decisions in front of clients. 

• Comfort integrating AI tools into a modern design workflow. 

 Preferred 

• Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, or medical communications is a significant plus. 

• Familiarity with regulated review processes (MLR/PRB) and compliant design considerations (fair balance, ISI placement, referencing). 

• Experience designing HCP- and patient-facing digital experiences. 

• Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system. 

 What we can offer 
 You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. 
 Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. 
 We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health .

 Senior Front-End Product Engineer
 React + UX + Data & AI Experiences
 Build the front door to biomedical discovery. 
 LOCATION : Remote Eligible
 CLEARANCE : Public Trust or ability to obtain one
 MISSION PARTNER : National Institutes of Health
 YOUR IMPACT

 What happens when biomedical data, modern AI, and exceptional product craft meet? The hard thing becomes clear, fast, and trustworthy.
 GDIT is looking for a senior front-end product engineer who can take an ambiguous mission problem from first conversation to production - and keep improving it after launch. This is an engineering-first role for someone who is equally comfortable interviewing users, sketching a flow, challenging a product assumption, designing an interaction model, and shipping a high-performance React application used by thousands of people or more.
 You will build data-rich and AI-enabled mission applications for the National Institutes of Health. You will not simply receive a mockup and turn it into code. You will help define the product: personas, journeys, information architecture, prototypes, design system, front-end architecture, delivery plan, telemetry, and production operations. The work will deploy across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps.
 Our goal: users should feel that a difficult mission workflow just became obvious. 
 THE ROLE

 This role lives at the intersection of product design, UX research, front-end architecture, data visualization, AI interaction design, and cloud delivery. You will partner with NIH mission stakeholders, domain experts, product leaders, designers, data scientists, AI engineers, back-end engineers, and platform teams to decide what should be built and then make it real.
 You will move fast, but not recklessly. You will use prototypes and evidence to reduce ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and take responsibility for the quality, accessibility, security, reliability, and impact of what reaches users.
 This is not a handoff role. It is an ownership role.
 MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

• Lead human-centered discovery through interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow observation, task analysis, and collaborative workshops with mission users and stakeholders.

• Turn research into clear personas, jobs-to-be-done, journey maps, service blueprints, information architecture, task flows, and product hypotheses.

• Prototype at the speed of learning - from sketches and Figma concepts to high-fidelity coded prototypes - and use feedback to decide what deserves production investment.

• Plan and facilitate usability studies, accessibility reviews, design critiques, and behavioral analysis; translate findings into prioritized product and engineering decisions.

 Engineer the product

• Architect and build production React and Next.js applications using TypeScript, the App Router, Server Components, Server Functions, streaming, modern caching, and intentionally small client-side boundaries.

• Create responsive, adaptive, accessible interfaces using semantic HTML, modern CSS, Tailwind CSS, design tokens, accessible component primitives, and purposeful motion.

• Build data-intensive experiences - dashboards, exploratory search, complex forms, virtualized tables, visual analytics, collaboration workflows, and real-time or streaming interfaces - without making users wrestle with the data model.

• Design AI-native experiences such as copilots, RAG and agentic workflows, assisted analysis, and generative interfaces with streaming feedback, source attribution, provenance, clear limitations, human approval points, and graceful failure states.

• Integrate GraphQL, REST and OpenAPI services, event streams, and back-end capabilities using generated types, runtime validation, resilient error handling, and secure authentication and authorization patterns.

• Choose the right home for state - URL, server, component, form, or shared client state - and implement caching, synchronization, optimistic interaction, and recovery with discipline.

• Build and evolve a reusable design system and component platform in Storybook so teams can ship consistent, accessible experiences faster.

 Ship and operate

• Own delivery from local development through production across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps, selecting managed, serverless, or container-based approaches that fit the mission and security context.

• Automate build, test, security, and deployment pipelines; use infrastructure as code, dependency and supply-chain controls, feature flags, progressive delivery, and repeatable environment promotion.

• Instrument the browser and application with logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, product analytics, and Core Web Vitals so the team can see what users experience and act on it.

• Create a balanced quality strategy spanning unit, component, contract, accessibility, visual, performance, and end-to-end tests. Treat production reliability and incident learning as part of product quality.

 Lead and elevate

• Set a forward-looking front-end roadmap, document architectural decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and keep the platform modern without chasing novelty for its own sake.

• Partner directly with users and leaders, explain complex technical choices clearly, invite dissent, and create alignment across design, product, data, AI, security, and engineering.

• Mentor engineers and designers, lead design and code reviews, establish front-end quality standards, and create a paved road that improves delivery across the team.

• Use AI-assisted design and development tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, coding, testing, documentation, and analysis while preserving human review, security, traceability, and engineering judgment.

• Measure outcomes, not output: adoption, task success, time on task, error rates, accessibility, performance, reliability, user confidence, and mission value.

 OUR MODERN FRONT-END TOOLBOX

 This is a toolbox, not a trivia test. You do not need every library on this list. You do need deep React fundamentals, current hands-on expertise, and the judgment to choose - or reject - a technology for the right reasons. 
 Core React and language: React, Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Server Functions, React Compiler, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, semantic HTML, modern CSS, browser APIs, Web Workers, and package management with pnpm.
 UI and design systems: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Base UI, React Aria or Radix UI, design tokens, Storybook, Figma, Motion, container queries, responsive and adaptive design, progressive enhancement, and component-driven development.
 Data, state, and forms: GraphQL, REST, OpenAPI, GraphQL Code Generator, TanStack Query, Zod, URL state, local React state, Zustand or Jotai when shared client state is justified, React Hook Form, WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, and streaming data patterns.
 Data visualization and scale: TanStack Table and Virtual, D3, Observable Plot, Vega-Lite, Apache ECharts, Canvas, WebGL or WebGPU when the workload calls for it, plus performance budgets, virtualization, code splitting, and efficient rendering of large datasets.
 AI experience engineering: Streaming model responses, RAG and agentic interactions, tool execution, source attribution and provenance, human-in-the-loop controls, feedback and evaluation workflows, transparent limitations, and resilient UX for latency, partial results, and model failure.
 Quality and accessibility: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Mock Service Worker, Storybook interaction and visual testing, automated accessibility checks, keyboard and screen-reader validation, WCAG, Section 508, and performance profiling.
 Cloud and operations: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, Bicep or cloud development kits, Azure, AWS, Databricks Apps, OAuth and OpenID Connect, role- and attribute-based access control, OpenTelemetry, centralized logs, metrics and traces, error tracking, feature flags, and product analytics.
 WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

• 5 or more years of professional front-end or product engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of senior-level impact, including ownership of production React applications.

• Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, browser behavior, component architecture, rendering, accessibility, and front-end performance.

• A record of taking products from vision through discovery, design, implementation, deployment, support, and iterative improvement - not only contributing isolated tickets.

• Experience shipping applications used by thousands of users or more, with practical knowledge of rollout, telemetry, reliability, support, performance, and change management at scale.

• A portfolio or case studies that show human-centered design thinking, personas and flows, prototypes, architectural decisions, shipped software, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.

• Hands-on skill conducting user research and usability testing, synthesizing ambiguous findings, and translating them into coherent interaction models and product decisions.

• Experience building data-heavy, API-driven applications and making disciplined choices about server state, client state, caching, forms, validation, real-time updates, and error recovery.

• Experience building or contributing to accessible design systems, reusable component libraries, and shared front-end standards.

• Experience deploying and operating modern web applications in at least one major cloud environment, with the ability to work across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps.

• Strong written and verbal communication, technical leadership, curiosity, self-direction, and comfort making progress when the problem is not yet well defined.

• Public Trust clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

 WHAT SETS YOU APART

• Direct experience with Databricks Apps, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, model serving, lakehouse patterns, or governed data and AI applications.

• Experience designing and shipping trustworthy AI products using RAG, multimodal models, agents, evaluation, source grounding, human review, and responsible AI patterns.

• Experience with biomedical, scientific, clinical, research, or public-health data; familiarity with FAIR data principles, FHIR, data provenance, or research data governance.

• Advanced data visualization experience involving high-dimensional, graph, temporal, geospatial, or very large datasets.

• Experience with Web Workers, WebAssembly, Canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, local-first or offline-capable applications, or other advanced browser capabilities.

• Experience with product experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, product analytics, and outcome-based product development.

• Experience delivering into secure or regulated federal environments, including Section 508, zero-trust identity, privacy, auditability, and DevSecOps controls.

• A history of raising the bar through technical strategy, mentoring, design-system leadership, open-source contribution, or front-end platform enablement.

 HOW WE'LL KNOW YOU'RE WINNING

• Users can complete complex mission workflows faster, with fewer errors, less training, and greater confidence in the data and AI supporting their decisions.

• The front-end platform becomes a force multiplier: reusable components, clear patterns, fast feedback, high-quality tests, and predictable deployments make the whole team more effective.

• Applications are fast, accessible, secure, observable, reliable, and supportable across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps - not just impressive in a demo.

• Production evidence and user feedback continuously shape the roadmap, and the team gets better at turning ambiguous mission needs into useful software.

 THE MISSION: NIH

 The National Institutes of Health seeks fundamental knowledge about living systems and applies that knowledge to enhance health, lengthen life, and reduce illness and disability. Learn about the NIH mission.
 NIH's current direction for data science emphasizes new opportunities in software, computational methods and artificial intelligence, along with a federated biomedical research data infrastructure. You will help turn those capabilities into usable mission experiences - interfaces that help people explore evidence, understand data, collaborate, and act with confidence. Explore the NIH Strategic Plan for Data Science.
 WHY GDIT

 GDIT is a global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services across the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence community.  Full-time · Remote (Canada based preferred) 

 Pixel One is a design studio for ambitious B2B SaaS teams. We embed with our clients, join their standups, and stay with their product as it evolves. Average client retention is 24+ months, which means you'll see what your work does to a business over years, not weeks.

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 

 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 About the role

 As a Brand Designer on Vercel's Core team, you'll help evolve the foundational visual language of a brand trusted by the most ambitious builders in the world. You'll create systems, experiences, and defining brand moments that are instantly recognizable, creatively ambitious, and built to scale.

 This is not a purely static design role. You'll work across brand systems, digital experiences, product launches, social, motion, print, events, environments, and the occasional piece of swag. We're looking for someone who can design, prototype, and use AI-assisted code to bring brand ideas to life.

 You're a tinkerer, a visual strategist, and a creative explorer. You create clarity from complexity and actively use AI throughout your workflow to design, prototype, automate, experiment, and write code. You push the work until it's sharp, then ship.

 This is craft at speed. It's a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who sweats the details, thinks in systems, and knows when to veer left for a one-off moment that makes people stop scrolling.

 We move quickly. The bar is high. Your work ships. 

 What you’ll do

• Design across mediums, including web, motion, 3D, social, print, swag, and environments, choosing whatever format best serves the story

• Direct and collaborate with external specialists — studios, freelancers, photographers, illustrators, printers, fabricators — when execution extends beyond your own craft

• Present and defend creative decisions, connecting visual choices to brand, product, audience, and business goals

 About you 

• 5+ years in brand, marketing, or visual design — ideally at a SaaS, developer tools, or fast-growing tech company

• A portfolio showing exceptional taste, systems thinking, and execution across mediums — not just polished final images, but how you think, build systems, collaborate, navigate constraints, and get work into production

• You don't need to be a full-time engineer, but you're technically curious, comfortable in code, and capable of shipping functional prototypes

• You think beyond static files and enjoy bringing ideas to life as real, interactive experiences

• Strong production knowledge across digital and physical formats — responsive design, asset delivery, print prep, environmental graphics, vendor production

• Understands how brand lives inside products and digital experiences, not just marketing campaigns

 We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability.
 Join Bite as our first in-house designer, initially for a 6 month contract, but with the potential to grow into our full time vacancy. Working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment.
 Why join Bite 
 The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product.
 You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. We're a small, agile, product-led team so if we need to pivot, we will prototype, test and build rapidly. You won’t find a feature factory or dependency delays here.
 Your work ships to people who pay. The platform beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions.
 What we're building 
 Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.
 Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of the detected changes to all affected files.
 
 What you’ll do 
 
• Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality.

• Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns.

• Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint.

• Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap.

• Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter.

• Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities.

• Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights.

• Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements.

• Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions.

• Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless.

• Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite.

 What we need from you 
 
• A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products).

• An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team.

• A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

• A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and fluency in data, using qualitative and quantitative signals to validate design decisions, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs.

• Demonstrated understanding of human-centred design principles and usability best practices, responsive design, product, technical, and business constraints in real-world environments.

• Demonstrable ability to build intuitive, user-centred experiences supported by a portfolio showing strong interaction design foundation, high-quality visual craft and attention to detail, structured problem framing and systems thinking, advanced experience working with AI-native research, design, and collaboration tools and advanced proficiency in Figma, including component-based design systems, auto layout, variables, prototyping logic, and developer collaboration workflows (e.g., Dev Mode, structured handoff).

• Evidence of shipping work that moved real business or operational metrics, and an ability to talk about those numbers fluently.

• The ability to connect design decisions and rationale to user outcomes, articulating trade-offs and measurable business impact.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, customer-ready documentation.

• Ability to move fluidly between the big question (what should this experience do?) and the craft-level detail that makes high-stakes decisions feel simple.

• Highly organised and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the design system and culture.

• Experience working autonomously to design complex, multi-step product flows.

 What you can expect from us 
 
• Fair and competitive salary

• Flexible, hybrid working

• Genuine ownership and an open and creative environment where you’ll help us define the future of Bite, what we work on and our culture

 Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours
 About the Role 
 At Pavago , we’re hiring a UX/UI Designer for one of our clients to design intuitive, visually polished, and high-performing digital experiences across web and mobile products.
 This is not simply a visual design role. You’ll own the design process from user research and UX strategy through wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI, design systems, and developer handoff .
 You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and leadership to understand user problems and translate them into digital experiences that are easy to use, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
 If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution and enjoy solving real product problems through design, this role is a strong fit.
 What You’ll Own 
 User Research & UX Strategy 

• Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.

• Identify user needs, pain points, and friction across digital experiences.

• Translate research into:

• Personas

• User journeys

• User flows

• Information architecture

• Wireframes

• Use behavioral and analytics tools such as Hotjar, FullStory, and Google Analytics to uncover opportunities for improvement.

• Recommend UX improvements based on qualitative and quantitative insights.

 Wireframing & Prototyping 

• Create low-fidelity wireframes to validate concepts and workflows.

• Build interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review.

• Develop high-fidelity product mockups using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch .

• Rapidly iterate based on user testing, stakeholder feedback, and QA findings.

• Clearly communicate interaction patterns and intended product behavior.

 UI & Product Design 

• Design clean, modern, and user-friendly interfaces.

• Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile .

• Balance usability, aesthetics, accessibility, and business objectives.

• Design user flows and conversion paths that minimize friction.

• Ensure interfaces are visually polished and production-ready.

 Design Systems & Scalability 

• Build and maintain scalable design systems and component libraries.

• Establish consistent standards for:

• Typography

• Color

• Spacing

• Layouts

• Components

• Interaction patterns

• Create reusable components that improve design and development efficiency.

• Maintain organized design files, assets, specifications, and documentation.

• Ensure consistency across products, features, and platforms.

 Accessibility & Usability 

• Apply WCAG accessibility standards throughout the design process.

• Consider contrast, readability, keyboard accessibility, responsiveness, and usability.

• Conduct usability reviews and identify opportunities to simplify workflows.

• Improve task completion, navigation, conversion paths, and overall product usability.

 Product & Engineering Collaboration 

• Work closely with:

• Product Managers

• Developers

• QA

• Leadership

• Participate in sprint planning, product discussions, and feature prioritization.

• Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation rather than only at handoff.

• Deliver developer-ready designs using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or InVision Inspect .

• Provide clear specifications, assets, and interaction documentation.

• Review implemented designs and help resolve inconsistencies before release.

 What Makes You a Strong Fit 

• You think about user journeys and product problems , not just individual screens.

• You combine strong visual design skills with practical UX thinking.

• You can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.

• You’re comfortable using research and data to challenge assumptions.

• You understand how UX impacts adoption, engagement, conversion, and satisfaction.

• You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You care about consistency, accessibility, and the small details that make products feel polished.

• You can iterate quickly without sacrificing design quality.

 Required Experience & Skills 

• 
 2+ years of professional UX/UI or Product Design experience.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating:

• UX problem-solving

• UI craftsmanship

• Responsive design

• Product design thinking

• Advanced proficiency with:

• Figma

• Adobe XD

• Sketch

• Experience creating:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity interfaces

• Responsive layouts

• Design systems

• Strong understanding of:

• UX and usability principles

• Interaction design

• Accessibility

• Responsive and mobile-first design

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote product environment.

 Preferred Experience 

• Experience designing:

• SaaS products

• Mobile applications

• E-commerce platforms

• Experience building or maintaining scalable design systems.

• Familiarity with:

• HTML/CSS fundamentals

• Developer workflows

• Agile/Scrum environments

• Experience with behavioral analytics tools such as:

• Hotjar

• FullStory

• Google Analytics

• Experience conducting A/B tests or design experiments.

• Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO).

• Experience collaborating directly with engineering teams through implementation.

 What a Typical Day Looks Like 
 A UX/UI Designer’s day revolves around understanding users, solving product problems, and translating ideas into intuitive experiences. You will:

• Analyze user behavior and identify UX opportunities.

• Create user flows and wireframes for new features.

• Build and test interactive prototypes.

• Design polished, responsive interfaces in Figma.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering during sprint execution.

• Refine and expand the product’s design system.

• Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback.

 In short: you turn user needs and business requirements into intuitive, scalable, and visually polished digital products.
 Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• Consistent implementation of design systems.

 Why This Role Stands Out 

• End-to-end ownership of UX and UI design.

• Opportunity to influence real product strategy and user experience.

• Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership.

• Build and improve scalable design systems.

• Strong career progression into:

 Apply Now

 Apply today and help create digital products that are intuitive, accessible, visually polished, and genuinely enjoyable to use .

Headquarters: Remote, United States
 
 URL: http://pressw.ai 

 About PressW

 PressW is where some of the world's most ambitious companies come to actually ship AI.

 We're redefining how businesses harness AI by building real systems for real clients, not just selling slides about what's possible. We're a team of three exited AI founders and a group of Applied AI Engineers based in Austin, and we've been heads-down for the last few years building this firm into something we're proud of: more than 70 production AI solutions shipped, 40+ clients across seven industries, and over $50M in measurable profit gains delivered. We work on the bleeding edge of what AI can do, guide our clients to the right solutions for their business, and ship the infrastructure they run on.

 We sell across three divisions. Managed AI is our MSP, purpose-built for institutional investors: private equity firms, venture capital funds, asset managers, and capital markets clients. We map how a firm actually works, deploy custom agents into the workflows that consume deal teams' time (reading deal documents, drafting IC memos, scoring targets, triaging inbound, structuring offers, monitoring portfolio companies), and keep evolving those systems as models and firm needs change. AI Engineering embeds our teams directly with clients to build and harden production AI systems. AI Transformation handles roadmap and readiness work, helping leaders figure out what to build, in what order, and how to prepare for it.

 Job Description

 You will own the user experience for PressW's healthcare scheduling platform rebuild (codename Phoenix), reporting to Engineering Leadership. The platform serves hundreds of thousands of workers across mobile and web, plus an admin interface used by 1,000+ healthcare facilities. Every user-facing surface is being rebuilt from scratch, and you are the person who determines what the new experience looks and feels like.

 This role starts before any frontend code is written. Your first months are research: auditing the existing platform's workflows, understanding where users struggle (template management is the #1 pain point and the top churn driver), and conducting customer research with the client's product and CS teams. That research directly informs the API design for each service group and the frontend architecture. By the time frontend engineering begins (~week 20-24), you have months of research behind the design system and component library you're handing off.

 Responsibilities

• 
 Lead internal platform audit and customer research (Phases 0-2). Map existing workflows, pain points, and user patterns. Work directly with the client's product and customer success teams to understand what needs to change and why.

• 
 Provide API design input during backend service group migrations (Phase 3). The REST API shapes should reflect how users actually work, not just how the database is structured.

• 
 Design the complete user experience across two frontend batches: worker-facing (schedule viewing, shift pickup, messaging, push notifications) and admin-facing (template management, schedule building, reporting, compliance). The admin batch is where the platform's NPS moves.

• 
 Build and maintain the design system and component library. Establish patterns for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA target), responsive design, and consistency across web and mobile.

• 
 Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Conduct usability testing to validate decisions before and during rollout.

• 
 Participate in frontend rollout feedback: usability testing with real users during wave rollouts, synthesizing feedback, and iterating on the design.

• 
 Present research findings and design decisions in weekly UX reviews with the Frontend Lead and client product team.

 Qualifications

• 
 Strong UX design experience with both web and mobile applications.

• 
 Experience conducting user research and translating findings into product design decisions.

• 
 Experience designing for complex, workflow-heavy applications (scheduling, operations, admin tooling, or similar).

• 
 Experience with legacy system transformation: understanding existing workflows well enough to redesign them without losing what works.

• 
 Ability to design for systems involving APIs and data integrations, with an understanding of how backend structure impacts UX decisions.

• 
 Proficiency with Figma or similar design tools.

• 
 Strong communication skills. You will present research findings and defend design decisions to both engineers and client stakeholders.

• 
 Must have shipped meaningful design work in the last 2 years.

 Preferred

• 
 Healthcare or regulated-environment design experience.

• 
 Design system and component library ownership.

• 
 Accessibility (WCAG) expertise.

• 
 Comfort with AI design tooling for quick iteration and prototyping.

• 
 Experience working in cross-functional teams alongside engineers on active builds.

 Why Join PressW

 You own the user experience end-to-end for a platform that hundreds of thousands of people use daily. Research through rollout, two apps, two audiences. Small team, high autonomy, real stakes.

 PressW is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Please note that only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview. Thank you for your interest in PressW!

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pressw-ux-designer

jobs.description_text:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

 From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

 The Role 

 You are someone who believes that good design has a critical role in solving every problem. You know design is not just how things look and feel, but also how every process evolves. Even 
 mundane processes from daily life can be made easier with a better design. You love products and have great creative skills. You want to own and be responsible for designing and driving products to completion. You religiously follow Buxton’s rule of producing at least 3 alternatives for every design decision. You respect the grid and hate all the half pixel aligned icons. You’re a multiple hat-wearer who can identify gaps and fill in for them. Someone who can drive ownership and widen the skill spectrum of your team. 

 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 As a Design Lead, you will: 

• Drive product and design ideation, planning and prioritization of our diverse range of products and features. 

• Drive user research, create detailed user journeys and take appropriate design decisions backed by user-behavior and data. Define design strategies by analyzing data models and derive best practices within the team. 

• Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams including Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data Science and various Business teams to deliver delightful customer experiences. Strategize, develop, and extend the visual design systems and pattern libraries by coming up with new and innovative solutions which suit the Razorpay brand. 

• Lead creative and holistic thinking across our diverse products and conduct design reviews and status meetings as needed. 

• Provide thought leadership on usability and user-centered design principles. Evangelize design within and outside the organization. 

• Actively take part in hiring and take part in recruiting the best talent required for the team. 

• Mentor and inspire a team of designers. Help the team in raising the bar, resolving blockers, prioritizing and breaking down complex projects into simpler tasks. 

• Brainstorm and create new directions that Razorpay can take in our quest to make finance easy and accessible to all. 

• Envisage & run strategic, design-only initiatives. For eg. fostering the design community, experiment with design practices, etc. 

 Mandatory Qualifications: 

 As a Lead Product Designer, we expect you to have : 

• At least 7+ years of experience in designing digital products with 2+ years of experience in leading a team of designers. 

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum development processes. 

• Keen in understanding short and long-term goals of the product and business. 

• Excellent understanding of behavioral analytics and you go by data-driven decisions. 

• Expertise in UI and interaction design with a deliberate focus on raising the bar for UI. 

• Prior work experience focussing on Mobile applications and a good understanding of the platform. 

• A good understanding of Frontend principles to guide the team from an engineering point of view. 

• Keen in applying user research, user-needs validation and usability evaluation. 

• Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to the team and leadership. 

 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. 

 Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

 We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.

 About the role 

• We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.

• This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.

• It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.

• You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.

• You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.

• You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.

• The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.

 What we’re looking for 

 You may be a strong fit if you have: 

• 7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.

• Experience formally managing or leading design teams.

• Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.

• A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.

• Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.

• Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.

• A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.

 We’d especially love to see

• Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.

• Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.

 Location and working model 

 This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.

 The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

 Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

 At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

 Benefits That Work For You

We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

• Whole-self care through wellness partnerships

• 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)

• Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens

• 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

 These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. 

 Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com .
